CFHostInfoType.doc: Values indicating the type of data that is to be resolved or the type of data that was resolved.

kCFHostAddresses.doc: Specifies that addresses are to be resolved or that addresses were resolved.

kCFHostNames.doc: Specifies that names are to be resolved or that names were resolved.

kCFHostReachability.doc: Specifies that reachability information is to be resolved or that reachability information was resolved.

kCFNetDiagnosticConnectionDown.doc: The connection does not appear to be working.

kCFNetDiagnosticConnectionIndeterminate.doc: The status of the connection is not known.

kCFNetDiagnosticConnectionUp.doc: The connection appears to be working.

kCFNetDiagnosticErr.doc: An error occurred that prevented the call from completing.

kCFNetDiagnosticNoErr.doc: No error occurred but there is no status.

CFNetServiceBrowserFlags.doc: Flags that the system passes to net service browser callbacks.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a flag value with the specified bitfield.

kCFNetServiceFlagIsDefault.doc: Specifies whether the resulting domain is the default registration or browse domain.

kCFNetServiceFlagIsDomain.doc: Specifies whether the result pertains to a search for domains or services.

kCFNetServiceFlagMoreComing.doc: A hint that the system will call the client’s callback function again soon.

kCFNetServiceFlagRemove.doc: Specifies whether the client should remove the result instead of adding it.

CFNetServiceMonitorType.doc: Record type specifier used to tell a service monitor the type of record changes to watch for.

CFNetServiceRegisterFlags.doc: Options to use when registering a service on the network.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a flag value with the specified bitfield.

kCFNetServiceFlagNoAutoRename.doc: Causes registrations to fail if a name conflict occurs.

CFNetServicesError.doc: Error codes that may be returned by CFNetServices functions or passed to CFNetServices callback functions.

kCFNetServicesErrorBadArgument.doc: A required argument was not provided.

kCFNetServicesErrorCancel.doc: The search or service was canceled.

kCFNetServicesErrorCollision.doc: An attempt was made to use a name that is already in use.

kCFNetServicesErrorInProgress.doc: A search is already in progress.

kCFNetServicesErrorInvalid.doc: Invalid data was passed to a CFNetServices function.

kCFNetServicesErrorMissingRequiredConfig.doc: A required configuration for local network access is missing.

kCFNetServicesErrorTimeout.doc: Resolution failed because the timeout was reached.

CFNetworkErrors.doc: This enumeration contains error codes returned under the error domain kCFErrorDomainCFNetwork.

kCFErrorHTTPAuthenticationTypeUnsupporte.doc: The client and server couldn’t agree on a supported authentication type.

kCFErrorHTTPBadCredentials.doc: The server rejected the credentials provided for an authenticated connection.

kCFErrorHTTPBadProxyCredentials.doc: The proxy rejected the authentication credentials provided for logging in.

kCFErrorHTTPBadURL.doc: The requested URL couldn’t be retrieved.

kCFErrorHTTPConnectionLost.doc: The connection to the server was dropped.

kCFErrorHTTPParseFailure.doc: The HTTP server response couldn’t be parsed.

kCFErrorHTTPProxyConnectionFailure.doc: A connection to the HTTPS proxy couldn’t be established.

kCFErrorHTTPRedirectionLoopDetected.doc: Too many HTTP redirects occurred before reaching a page that didn’t redirect the client to another page.

kCFErrorHTTPSProxyConnectionFailure.doc: A connection couldn’t be established to the HTTPS proxy.

kCFErrorPACFileAuth.doc: The authentication credentials provided by the proxy autoconfiguration file were rejected.

kCFErrorPACFileError.doc: An error occurred with the proxy autoconfiguration file.

kCFFTPErrorUnexpectedStatusCode.doc: The server returned an unexpected status code.

kCFHTTPCookieCannotParseCookieFile.doc: The cookie file can’t be parsed.

kCFNetServiceErrorBadArgument.doc: A required argument either wasn’t provided or wasn’t valid.

kCFNetServiceErrorCancel.doc: The search or service was canceled.

kCFNetServiceErrorCollision.doc: An attempt was made to use a name that’s already in use.

kCFNetServiceErrorDNSServiceFailure.doc: The DNS service discovery returned an error.

kCFNetServiceErrorInProgress.doc: A new search couldn’t be started because a search is already in progress.

kCFNetServiceErrorInvalid.doc: Invalid data was passed to a CFNetServices function.

kCFNetServiceErrorTimeout.doc: Resolution failed because the timeout was reached.

kCFNetServiceErrorUnknown.doc: An error of unknown type has occurred.

kCFSOCKS4ErrorIdConflict.doc: The server rejected the request because the client program and the identd daemon reported different user IDs.

kCFSOCKS4ErrorIdentdFailed.doc: The server couldn’t connect to the identd daemon on the client and rejected the request.

kCFSOCKS4ErrorRequestFailed.doc: The server rejected the request, or the request failed.

kCFSOCKS4ErrorUnknownStatusCode.doc: The server returned an unknown status code.

kCFSOCKS5ErrorBadCredentials.doc: The SOCKS server refused the client connection because of bad login credentials.

kCFSOCKS5ErrorBadResponseAddr.doc: The address type returned isn’t supported.

kCFSOCKS5ErrorBadState.doc: The stream isn’t in a state that allows the requested operation.

kCFSOCKS5ErrorNoAcceptableMethod.doc: The client and server couldn’t find a mutually agreeable authentication method.

kCFSOCKSErrorUnknownClientVersion.doc: The SOCKS server rejected access because it doesn’t support connections with the requested SOCKS version.

kCFSOCKSErrorUnsupportedServerVersion.doc: The SOCKS server doesn’t support the requested version.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPSProxyFailureUnexpecte.doc: The HTTPS proxy returned an unexpected status code, such as a 3xx redirect.

kCFURLErrorAppTransportSecurityRequiresS.doc: The connection failed because the App Transport Security configuration requires a secure connection.

kCFURLErrorBackgroundSessionInUseByAnoth.doc: The background session failed because it was in use by another process.

kCFURLErrorBackgroundSessionWasDisconnec.doc: The background session failed because it was disconnected.

kCFURLErrorBadServerResponse.doc: The connection received an invalid server response.

kCFURLErrorBadURL.doc: The connection failed due to a malformed URL.

kCFURLErrorCallIsActive.doc: The connection failed because a call is active.

kCFURLErrorCannotConnectToHost.doc: The connection failed because a connection can’t be made to the host.

kCFURLErrorCannotDecodeContentData.doc: The connection can’t decode data encoded with an unknown content encoding.

kCFURLErrorCannotDecodeRawData.doc: The connection can’t decode data encoded with a known content encoding.

kCFURLErrorCannotFindHost.doc: The connection failed because the host couldn’t be found.

kCFURLErrorCannotLoadFromNetwork.doc: The connection failed because it’s being required to return a cached resource, but one isn’t available.

kCFURLErrorCannotParseResponse.doc: The connection can’t parse the server’s response.

kCFURLErrorClientCertificateRejected.doc: The secure connection failed because the client’s certificate was rejected.

kCFURLErrorClientCertificateRequired.doc: The secure connection failed because the server requires a client certificate.

kCFURLErrorDNSLookupFailed.doc: The connection failed because the DNS lookup failed.

kCFURLErrorDataLengthExceedsMaximum.doc: The file operation failed because the file is too large.

kCFURLErrorDataNotAllowed.doc: The connection failed because data use isn’t currently allowed on the device.

kCFURLErrorDownloadDecodingFailedMidStre.doc: The download failed because decoding of the downloaded data failed midstream.

kCFURLErrorDownloadDecodingFailedToCompl.doc: The download failed because decoding of the downloaded data failed to complete.

kCFURLErrorFileDoesNotExist.doc: The file operation failed because the file doesn’t exist.

kCFURLErrorFileIsDirectory.doc: The file operation failed because the file is a directory.

kCFURLErrorFileOutsideSafeArea.doc: The file is outside of the safe area.

kCFURLErrorHTTPTooManyRedirects.doc: The HTTP connection failed due to too many redirects.

kCFURLErrorInternationalRoamingOff.doc: The connection failed because international roaming is disabled on the device.

kCFURLErrorNetworkConnectionLost.doc: The connection failed because the network connection was lost.

kCFURLErrorNoPermissionsToReadFile.doc: The file operation failed because it doesn’t have permission to read the file.

kCFURLErrorNotConnectedToInternet.doc: The connection failed because the device isn’t connected to the internet.

kCFURLErrorRedirectToNonExistentLocation.doc: The connection was redirected to a nonexistent location.

kCFURLErrorRequestBodyStreamExhausted.doc: The connection failed because the request’s body stream was exhausted.

kCFURLErrorSecureConnectionFailed.doc: The secure connection failed for an unknown reason.

kCFURLErrorServerCertificateHasBadDate.doc: The secure connection failed because the server’s certificate has an invalid date.

kCFURLErrorServerCertificateHasUnknownRo.doc: The secure connection failed because the server’s certificate has an unknown root.

kCFURLErrorServerCertificateNotYetValid.doc: The secure connection failed because the server’s certificate isn’t valid yet.

kCFURLErrorServerCertificateUntrusted.doc: The secure connection failed because the server’s certificate isn’t trusted.

kCFURLErrorUnsupportedURL.doc: The connection failed due to an unsupported URL scheme.

kCFURLErrorUserAuthenticationRequired.doc: The connection failed because it requires authentication.

kCFURLErrorUserCancelledAuthentication.doc: The connection failed because the user cancelled required authentication.

kCFURLErrorZeroByteResource.doc: The resource retrieved by the connection is zero bytes.

CFStreamErrorHTTP.doc: Error codes that a read stream for an HTTP request may return.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPBadURL.doc: The URL is not properly formatted.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPParseFailure.doc: A parsing error occurred while an incoming message was being deserialized and appended to a message object. The headers of the incoming message may be formatted improperly.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPRedirectionLoop.doc: A redirection loop has been detected.

CFStreamErrorHTTPAuthentication.doc: Authentication error codes that may be returned when trying to apply authentication to a request.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPAuthenticationBadPassw.doc: Password is in a format that is not suitable for the request. Currently, passwords are decoded using kCFStringEncodingISOLatin1.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPAuthenticationBadUserN.doc: User name is in a format that is not suitable for the request. Currently, user names are decoded using kCFStringEncodingISOLatin1.

kCFStreamErrorHTTPAuthenticationTypeUnsu.doc: Specified authentication type is not supported.

CFHostClientContext.doc: A structure containing user-defined data and callbacks for CFHost objects.

CFNetServiceClientContext.doc: A structure provided when a CFNetService is associated with a callback function or when a CFNetServiceBrowser is created.
